name: PS Lightwave
notes: PS Lightwave, LLC is a premier facilities-based telecommunications provider based in Houston, Texas, that operates a private, all-fiber-optic network covering approximately 5,500 route miles across nine counties. Founded in 2010, the company delivers high-speed internet, managed Gigabit Ethernet, dark fiber, and VoIP services to over 2,500 on-net locations, including commercial enterprises, government agencies, energy companies, and educational institutions. We provide secure, reliable data transmission, fully backed by a locally staffed 24/7/365 Network Operations Center.
